    (env : Environment) (sourceNames : List String) (provenance : Source.Provenance)
    (compilerCode : List (Int × (String × String))) (namedErrorSourceOrder : Bool) :
    Except String SolcContract :=
  readContract ast name ren testing
    (rewriteSpecBindings env sourceNames) (rewriteLoopBindings env sourceNames)
    (if provenance.legacyFixture then fun _ => default else fun request =>
      (Admission.scan ast provenance { request with
        declarationRoots := request.declarationRoots ++
          [Admission.header [] ast] ++ (J.arrD ast "nodes").toList.filter (J.kind · == "PragmaDirective") }).append
        (scanSpecifications env sourceNames request) |>.normalize |>.requireCompilerCode (!compilerCode.isEmpty))

        specifications := [(bound, "/// @custom:key " ++ text)] })
    (readsSpecification env sourceNames) entrypoints
    (!provenance.legacyFixture && provenance.pipeline == some .viaIR) compilerCode namedErrorSourceOrder

/-- Validate the schema against the selected binary and AST pragmas.
The helper's successful solc analysis checks version constraints and types. -/
def read (fixture ast : Json) : Except String Provenance := do
  unless (← ast.getObjValAs? String "nodeType") == "SourceUnit" do
    throw "source provenance requires a SourceUnit AST"
  let header ← fixture.getObjVal? "header"
  let solkeyCommit ← header.getObjValAs? String "solkeyCommit"
  let compiler ← parseCompiler (← header.getObjValAs? String "solcVersion")
  let source ← header.getObjValAs? String "source"
  let sourceSha256 ← header.getObjValAs? String "sourceSha256"
  unless !source.isEmpty && digest sourceSha256 do throw "malformed source provenance"
  let pragmas ← readPragmas ast
  match (header.getObjVal? "provenanceVersion").toOption with
  | none =>
    unless onlyKeys header ["solcVersion", "sourceSha256", "solkeyCommit", "source"] do
      throw "incomplete modern provenance cannot become a legacy fixture"
    return {
      compiler, solkeyCommit, source, sourceSha256
      requestedCoder := pragmas.requestedCoder
      gates := pragmas.gates, compilation := .historical }
  | some schema =>
    unless onlyKeys header ["solcVersion", "sourceSha256", "solkeyCommit", "source",
        "provenanceVersion", "compilerFile", "compilerSha256", "validationStage",
        "settings", "acceptedPragmas"] do throw "unknown source provenance field"
    unless schema.getNat?.toOption == some 1 do throw "unknown source provenance schema"
    unless (← header.getObjValAs? String "compilerFile") == compiler.file &&
        (← header.getObjValAs? String "compilerSha256") == compiler.sha256 do
      throw "compiler binary provenance does not match its exact pin"
    unless (← header.getObjValAs? String "validationStage") == "analysis" do
      throw "unknown source validation stage"
    let settings ← header.getObjVal? "settings"
    let viaIR ← validateSettings settings
    let pipeline := if viaIR then Pipeline.viaIR else .legacy
    let recorded ← header.getObjValAs? (Array (Array String)) "acceptedPragmas"
    let actual ← (← ast.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "nodes").toList.filterMapM fun node => do
      if (node.getObjValAs? String "nodeType").toOption == some "PragmaDirective" then
        return some (← node.getObjValAs? (Array String) "literals")
      else return none
    unless recorded.toList == actual do throw "recorded pragmas disagree with the source AST"
    return {
      compiler, solkeyCommit, source, sourceSha256
      requestedCoder := pragmas.requestedCoder
      gates := pragmas.gates, compilation := .analysed pipeline settings.compress }

def keccakMaxBytes : Nat := 64

/-- **The hash of a byte string read off the memory** (Lean only): where
its length and every byte read down the memory to literals, the hash `k` is
evaluated on them (`HashKind.apply`); where the memory does not return, the
symbol as it was. -/
def keccakAt (k : HashKind) (X : LTm C .mem) (t : LTm C (.ident (.array (.prim .uint)))) : LTm C (.val .uint) :=

/-- Only the canonical byte-buffer rethrow; no other assembly is erased. -/
def memoryRethrow? (declarations : List Json) (j : Json) : Option Json := do
  let ast ← J.opt j "AST"
  guard (J.kind ast == "YulBlock")
  let [stmt] ← (J.arr? ast "statements").map Array.toList | none
  guard (J.kind stmt == "YulExpressionStatement")
  let [ptr, len] ← yulArgs? "revert" (← J.opt stmt "expression") | none
  let [data, offset] ← yulArgs? "add" ptr | none
  let [same] ← yulArgs? "mload" len | none
  guard (J.kind data == "YulIdentifier" && J.kind same == "YulIdentifier")
  let name ← J.str? data "name"
  guard (J.str? same "name" == some name)
  guard (J.kind offset == "YulLiteral" && J.str? offset "kind" == some "number")
  guard (((J.str? offset "value").bind parseRational).bind Q.int? == some 32)
  let [left, right] ← (J.arr? j "externalReferences").map Array.toList | none
  let declaration (r : Json) : Option Int := do
    guard (J.opt r "isOffset" == some (.bool false) && J.opt r "isSlot" == some (.bool false))
    guard ((r.getObjValAs? Nat "valueSize").toOption == some 1)
    (r.getObjValAs? Int "declaration").toOption
  guard ((declaration left).isSome && declaration left == declaration right)
  let id ← declaration left
  let decl ← declarations.find? (J.id? · == some id)
  guard (J.kind decl == "VariableDeclaration" && J.tyStr decl == "bytes" &&
    J.str? decl "storageLocation" == some "memory" && J.str? decl "name" == some name)
  pure decl

currentDeclarations.quote:
- **A write through a reference to a popped element writes the slot.**
  `Token storage r = tokens[0]; tokens.pop(); r.value = 5;` writes the
  cleared slot. A subsequent zero-argument `push()` of a struct or array
  saves only the length (`storagePushLengthSave`, `pushSlot`) and exposes
  the slot as it is, as solc does, so the model reads `5` from
  `tokens[0].value` (`reused_slot_retains_value`,
  `Examples/Tactics/CleanTail.lean`). Nothing then tells what a recycled
  slot of the starting storage holds; `ValidTail .clean` assumes its tails
  clean (`docs/options.md`, O6). A primitive slot past the end holds its
  default on every reachable storage, so a primitive push starts there; a `pop()`
  clears the element into the shadow (`storagePopSave`), but keeps a mapping
  element as it is (`storagePopSaveMappingElement`). These dangling executions
  are compiler-specific/undefined; the old resurrection specifications are
  migration cases to reclassify, not portable Solidity guarantees.
